title: The Unexplained Signature

journalBlocks.text: The fourth signature occupied an unusual place in the old diagram. The other marks sat beside the paths being traced. This one stood beside an empty comparison space. A narrow return stroke joined it to the place where an observation could be entered after the work was done.
The missing participant had not merely supplied another strand. He had been assigned to check what the diagram claimed against what someone actually experienced.
Removing that signature had also removed a place from which the plan could be questioned.
